description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeTrackerSearchFilterParams' within the 'OrangeHRM\Performance\Dto' namespace. The class extends 'FilterParams' and encapsulates filtering parameters for employee tracker searches, including fields for tracker IDs, employee number, and inclusion options (current, past, or both). It also sets default sorting behavior and provides getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for specifying search filters when querying employee tracker records, allowing filtering by tracker IDs, employee number, and inclusion status, with default sorting parameters.

methods.name: getTrackerIds
methods.description: Returns the array of tracker IDs to filter on, or null if not set.

methods.name: setTrackerIds
methods.description: Sets the array of tracker IDs to filter on.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current include employees filter value.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the include employees filter value.
